headline: Charleston and Davis & Elkins play on
dek: Both won their latest by a single goal, and theirs are the only two matches left on the conference calendar. Between them they have lost three times in thirty-eight; each of the other eight programmes has lost at least five.
displaced_by: Charleston now also have a match left, at home to Gannon, so the standing line that Davis & Elkins alone still had one no longer holds.
